summary: Factual inaccuracy in ChainingSyntax documentation and style issues in method-level Scaladoc.

items.issue: The description 'Provides implicit conversions that add chaining methods to every type' is factually incorrect. The trait only provides an implicit conversion to ChainingOps, not 'chaining methods' directly. The chaining methods (e.g., `pipe`, `tap`) are defined in ChainingOps, not here.
items.suggestion: Change to: 'Provides an implicit conversion to [[scala.util.ChainingOps]] for any type.'

items.issue: The description 'Returns a [[scala.util.ChainingOps]] wrapper for the given value' is misleading. The method does not return a wrapper; it returns a new ChainingOps instance that wraps the value. The term 'wrapper' is vague and could imply a type alias or proxy, which is not the case.
items.suggestion: Change to: 'Creates a new [[scala.util.ChainingOps]] instance wrapping the given value.'

items.issue: The @param description 'the value to be wrapped' is redundant with the @tparam description and could be more precise. The value is not 'wrapped' in the traditional sense; it is passed to the ChainingOps constructor.
items.suggestion: Change to: 'the value to be passed to the ChainingOps constructor'

items.issue: The @tparam description 'the type of the value to be wrapped' uses 'wrapped' inconsistently with the method description. Prefer consistency with the method's prose.
items.suggestion: Change to: 'the type of the value to be passed to the ChainingOps constructor'
